messages:
omar_oncall: seeing a spike of 503s for console in west1, users can't open session lists. Also a bunch of auth failures to the control plane: "401 invalid token" returned intermittently. GPU nodes in pool-gpu-west1 marked NotReady in k8s.

amber_sre: got the alert. console proxy logs show TLS handshake errors to control plane leader IP, plus our authz service is returning 500s. routing table shows frequent route recalculations.

luis_infra: i'm seeing high heartbeat latencies from controlplane members in west1 — pings up to 3s, jitter large. kube-apiserver can't reach the controller that owns config rollouts. suspect network fabric between racks.

raj_platform: starting traffic-shift play: move user-facing console traffic away from west1 to na-central1. will trigger nginx reload on edge-proxies with new upstream weight 0 -> 100. tagging this as P1.

deploy-bot: deploy request received: edge-proxy-weight-update by raj_platform. CI gating checks ok.

incident-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0442 (west1 ctrlplane heartbeat spike / console access). Paging oncall and SRE.

omar_oncall: rolling a quick auth fallback: set AUTHZ_READ_REPLICA_TIMEOUT=800ms -> 1200ms in the auth-proxy config on frontends to reduce 500s. patching via kustomize, applying now:
```bash
kubectl -n infra set env deployment/auth-proxy AUTHZ_READ_REPLICA_TIMEOUT=1200
kubectl rollout restart deployment/auth-proxy -n infra
```

amber_sre: confirmed auth-proxy rollout started, pods restarting. but some frontends still get 502 from upstreams. logs: "upstream unreachable: no healthy host" from envoy.

luis_infra: checking node status: a subset of the GPU nodes in az-west1-b are in NotReady with kernel OOM killer events reported. nv_peer_mem shows errors. suspect the driver update we pushed earlier caused instability combined with flapping network paths.

raj_platform: continuing traffic movement. will also adjust canary so that Dedicated GPU provisioning requests go to other regions: set route policy for allocate.gpu to prefer na-central1, fallback eu-west1. applying policy change in policy-service.

omar_oncall: FYI cost impact: shifting GPU provisioning across regions will bump egress and instance hour costs temporarily. posting numbers in #finance later. priority is restoring API surface.

amber_sre: mitigation checklist: 1) divert console & API traffic from west1 
2) scale auth-proxy replicas in fallback regions 
3) cordon unhealthy GPU nodes and disable auto-provisioner from scheduling there 
4) roll back driver update on a sample node to confirm root cause

luis_infra: cordoned affected nodes: gpu-node-az3-{12..15}. disabling provisioner: set provisioner.maxBurst=0 for west1.

raj_platform: edge weights updated, ~85% traffic now in na-central1, 15% in eu-west1. monitoring latency & error-rate. console 200s are returning to normal for most users.

omar_oncall: observed auth 401 rate drop ~70% after traffic shift and auth-proxy timeout bump. still seeing occasional controlplane leader election churn logs.

amber_sre: next steps: continue cordon + rollback driver on one node, let it stabilize, then progressively rollback if it fixes OOM/kmod errors. also open ticket with networking (netops) for fabric flaps between azs.

luis_infra: did a rollback on gpu-node-az3-12: kernel OOM logs stopped, nv_peer_mem OK, node became Ready after 90s. will roll forward one at a time.

raj_platform: adding a temporary policy to prevent global autoscaler from moving GPU jobs into west1 while we're in degraded state. setting annotation: autoscaler.k8s.restricted=west1:deny.

omar_oncall: incident timeline note: started at 2067890123. mitigations in flight. tagging this thread for postmortem.

incident-bot: incident status updated: mitigations applied, continued monitoring. next update in 30m.

amber_sre: logging: capture stack traces from auth-service and envoy for the window 2067890000-2067890600 and attach to INC-2026-0442. also keep a snapshot of controlplane leader endpoints.

omar_oncall: thanks team. will start draft for postmortem once we've confirmed driver rollback completes and controlplane stable for 2h. :thumbsup:
